cohort: 465 singleton preterm deliveries (24 + 0 to 36 + 6 weeks) following PPROM between 2007-2014
finding: Smaller cervical dilatation prior to delivery is an independent risk factor for cesarean delivery in pregnancies complicated by PPROM.
mod_finding: Smaller cervical dilatation prior to delivery is an independent risk factor for cesarean delivery in pregnancies complicated by PPROM.
